clack-hero-mascot.statement: The Clack hero displays the repository mascot beside the tagline and keeps both tagline lines readable at mobile and desktop widths.
clack-hero-mascot.falsifier: The emoji remains, the mascot fails to load or appears on a line by itself, or either tagline is clipped.
